description: Launch TikTok on the character's phone
goal: Day 3 of the phone. Walked on GeeLark explorer-us (TikTok 46.8.2, 2026-09-16 by email — refused at the phone gate — and 2026-09-18 by the character's US line, which created the account; account-creation.md §4 ter, screens-tiktok-actions.md §6)

description: Cold start — TikTok is slow on first open
Start a signup
Never a social login: the account must belong to this character only

prompt: TikTok asks for the birthday FIRST, on a wheel that is NOT editable (unlike Instagram's): about 6 notches per 340 px swipe at 400 ms. Set {birthday} (18+, R2) and tap Next. Then resume.
description: Birthday, before anything else (verified)

The Phone tab — BY NUMBER, not by email: an email signup is accepted and then blocked by 'For security purposes, link your phone number to your account', whose Back only rewinds to the code screen (§4 ter). The number is asked either way; asking it first is one gate instead of two. TikTok derives the username from the nickname typed later, so the handle is set there
The number field (US country code pre-selected on a US-located phone)
The character's OWN US line, digits only, bought for this character and never shared: 'This phone number is already taken' is what a reused number gets (§4 ter)
Ask for the SMS code

prompt: Read the 6-digit code on the character's line (short-code SMS reach the line abroad, numeros-us.md) and type it with POST /api/phone/type. Write 'sms: line-<character> <date> tiktok' in the ledger notes — never the number. Then resume.
description: SMS code (verified: delivered and accepted on 2026-09-18)

prompt: Type the TikTok password for {handle} on the device. Read it from the Keychain (ofmai-social-tiktok-<slug>) and type it with POST /api/phone/type; it is never a parameter of this run (R9). Tap Next, then resume.
description: Password — typed by a human

prompt: TikTok may ask for an email as a recovery address: type {email} (the character's own mailbox, whose app is on this phone) and the 6-digit code from the phone's notifications (GET /api/phone/notifications/<serial>). If no email screen is shown, just resume.
description: Recovery email — only if asked (not seen on the phone-first run)

prompt: If a slider or a 'select 2 objects' puzzle is on screen — those same strings are health.py's `verification` patterns, at signup they are a normal gate — solve it by hand (R25). Three failures in a row end the day. If there is no puzzle, just resume.
description: Captcha — possible on TikTok (not seen on the phone-first run)

prompt: Nickname screen: type {name}. TikTok DERIVES THE USERNAME FROM THE NICKNAME ('Jordan Reed' -> @jordan.reed90, verified) — the handle {handle} is set in the profile editor afterwards. Dismiss the interest picker and any follow suggestion without following anyone (R16). Then resume.
description: Nickname, interests, first feed
Profile tab of the bottom bar (648, 1322)
Open the profile editor

prompt: Profile editor: Username -> {handle} (fallback handles 2 and 3 of the sheet if taken); Name -> {name}; Bio -> {bio} (one line, ASCII, no link: TikTok gates links anyway and R22 forbids one before day 24); picture -> the MOST RECENT gallery item, the watermarked SFW variant pushed with adb push minutes ago. Save. Then resume.
description: Username, name, bio, avatar (editor labels not mined, R34)

prompt: Privacy: the account stays public, and 'Suggest your account to others' goes OFF (Settings and privacy > Privacy). Do not touch anything that looks like an AI label: on TikTok the AIGC label is posted per post, from the publication order, never as an account setting (R2, R3). Then resume.
description: Privacy settings
Back to the profile

prompt: Last look: the profile shows @{handle}, the bio and the picture, and no link. Register it on the Mac mini the same day — accounts add tiktok @{handle} --device <GeeLark profile> --tz <persona tz> --created-on <today> — then resume to close the run.
description: The run ends on the profile screen showing {handle}
